description: This Java source file defines the class MessageOnlyLogFilter, which implements the LogNode interface. It functions as a filter in a logging chain, passing only message data to the next node, effectively removing metadata like priority, tags, and throwable information. The class provides constructors to set the next LogNode and methods to get and set this next node, as well as to output log messages, but it filters out all data except the message content.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log node that filters out all log details except the message content, simplifying the log output for on-screen display or other uses where detailed metadata is unnecessary.
